blocks.en: The usefulness of the concept of weak-* convergence is to a large extent based on the following result.
blocks.zh: 弱-* 收敛概念的实用性在很大程度上基于以下结果.

blocks.en: Let $X$ be a separable Banach space and let $f_n$ be a bounded sequence in $X^*$. Then $f_n$ has a weakly-* convergent subsequence.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 为可分 Banach 空间, $f_n$ 为 $X^*$ 中的有界序列. 那么 $f_n$ 有一个弱-* 收敛子序列.
blocks.label: thm:alaoglu-weak-star-subsequence

blocks.en: In the typical applications of this theorem, the $f_n$ are approximate solutions to a PDE. While it may be difficult to show that the sequence converges, one can often obtain bounds on the sequence which imply a weakly convergent subsequence. The limit of the subsequence is then shown to be the solution of the original PDE.
blocks.zh: 在该定理的典型应用中, $f_n$ 为某个 PDE 的近似解. 虽然可能难以证明该序列收敛, 但往往可以得到该序列的界, 从而得到一个弱收敛子序列. 然后证明这一子序列的极限为原 PDE 的解.
blocks.label: rem:weak-compactness-approximate-pde-solutions
